title: Evidence Matrix
description: Draft evidence requirements derived from GSP Standard candidates via LLM semantic analysis (C6A). Each record specifies what evidence would demonstrate compliance with a GSP standard.

gsp_standard_title.description: C6A: Title of the linked GSP standard candidate.

source_customer_requirement_links.description: C6A: Traceability back to customer requirement master records.

source_original_text_refs.description: C6A: References to source_text_archive IDs for original IWAY text.

evidence_title.description: C6A: Human-readable title for this evidence requirement.

evidence_requirement_statement.description: C6A: Full description of what evidence is required and why.

evidence_type.description: C6A: Categorised type of evidence proposed by LLM.

evidence_owner_function.description: C6A: Function accountable for providing this evidence (e.g., HR, EHS, Production, QA).

evidence_responsible_department.description: C6A: Department responsible for maintaining this evidence.

evidence_frequency.description: C6A: How often this evidence must be collected or updated.

evidence_format.description: C6A: Expected format of the evidence.

evidence_acceptance_criteria.description: C6A: What constitutes acceptable evidence (what an auditor would accept).

evidence_retention_requirement.description: C6A: How long evidence must be retained (e.g., '3 years', 'until next audit').

risk_level.description: C6A: Risk level if this evidence is missing or inadequate.

llm_reasoning_summary.description: C6A: Summary of why the LLM proposed this evidence requirement.

uncertainty_notes.description: C6A: Notes about uncertainty, ambiguity, or alternative interpretations.

needs_human_review.description: C6A: True if the LLM flagged this evidence as needing human verification.

review_status.description: C6A: Initial status is always draft_pending_review.

approval_status.description: C6A: Initial status is always not_approved.

evidence_generation_method.description: C6A: How this evidence record was generated.

generated_by.description: C6A: System or user that generated this record.

batch_id.description: C6A: Batch identifier for the generation run.

sample_only.description: C6A: True if based on sample/test candidates, not real IWAY data.

created_by.description: C6A: User ID or system that created this record.

id.description: Legacy ID field (backward compat). Same as evidence_id.

core_requirement_id.description: Legacy FK to gsp_core_standard.id (backward compat). Same as gsp_standard_id.

status.description: Legacy lifecycle status (backward compat). C6A uses review_status instead.

evidence_description.description: Legacy field (backward compat). C6A uses evidence_requirement_statement.

collection_frequency.description: Legacy field (backward compat). C6A uses evidence_frequency.

retention_period_months.description: Legacy field (backward compat). C6A uses evidence_retention_requirement.
